title: Revengeance is Minor, Part Blue
description: Revengeance is Minor, Part Blue — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Search through Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace for Halfassin White. Once you find him, kill him before he kills you. Afterward, report the kill to [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Search through Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace for Halfassin White. Once you find him, kill him before he kills you. Afterward, report the kill to [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Halfassin White says he killed me? Well, I killed *him*! Don't be confused by the fact that I am dead right now. It's a temporary circumstance brought about by a completely separate happenstance, I assure you. Anyway, if he's not dead right now, I'm sure he's teetering on the edge. Do me a favor and go find him on Level 1 and deliver the final blow. Then go to Leda Beaurde and make sure I get the proper kill credit.

Turn-in:

Another Halfassin wants me to track his kills? What a hassle. You know why they're called Halfassins, right? Because each one is worth only half of a *real* assassin.

Objectives:

  • Kill Halfassin White

Client level range: 47–100
